heard: Their city or yours. Faulty phone, no reply, and the companies in another state. Under the Consumer Protection Act, you can file where you live or work. File it yourself on EJGreedy and appear in person. A lawyer is optional. The deadline, two years from when the problem arose. The Commission can order a repair, replacement, refund, or compensation. Keep your bill and every reply, then file with your district commission. Follow Courtlands for everyday Indian law explained.
